description: Scan prose for filler words (very, just, really), hedge phrases (kind of, I think), and clichés (at the end of the day, circle back), returning each matched phrase with its category, occurrence count, and character offsets, plus an overall density. Dictionary-based heuristic: a flagged word is a candidate to reconsider, not always wrong in context.

text.description: The prose to scan for filler words and clichés

name: detect_filler_words
